scope: Read-only published metadata geometric plausibility gate, not original feature or archive byte verification
interpretation: Reported 0.070569m maximum node drift is geometrically compatible with nearest 0.1m rounding in 2D EPSG:5179 (upper bound sqrt(2)*0.05m). Same-cell exact endpoints may differ by up to sqrt(2)*0.1m; two >10cm spread nodes therefore do not by themselves demonstrate a quantization implementation bug. This is a necessary plausibility bound, not proof that node assignment, source provenance, or trail connectivity is correct.
